legend: Karamell, Caramel, Caramello or Caramelo. Different languages, but you know what I'm talking about. Alice and Bob are twins and they also love caramels! So, as a birthday present, they asked for caramels to all the guests at the party they are organizing.
The day of the party Alice and Bob received their presents: N$$$N$$$ bags of caramels. The i$$$i$$$-th bag contained ai$$$a_i$$$ caramels.

Alice and Bob don't want to open the bags right away, they decided to distribute the caramels in the following way: the bags will be considered in order and, at the i$$$i$$$-th step, the ai$$$a_i$$$ caramels from the i$$$i$$$-th bag are given to the person who has the least caramels at that moment. In case of a tie, Alice gets the caramels (after all, "ladies first").

One thing they didn't like is that, depending on the order in which the bags are considered, the final amount of caramels that each person receives can be different. For example, if the bags were ordered in the quantities described by the sequence [1,2,2,3]$$$[1, 2, 2, 3]$$$, Alice would end up with 3$$$3$$$ and Bob would end up with 5$$$5$$$ candies. On the other hand, if they were considered in the order [1,2,3,2]$$$[1, 2, 3, 2]$$$, both would end up with 4$$$4$$$.

You forgot to buy candies for the birthday children, but you decided to give them an even more interesting gift: a program that determines a way to order the bags so that Alice and Bob get the same amount of candies, if possible.
input: The first line contains a single integer N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤100)$$$1 \leq N \leq 100)$$$, indicating the number of bags. The second line contains N$$$N$$$ integers a1,…,aN$$$a_1, \ldots, a_N$$$ (1≤ai≤100)$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 100)$$$, where ai$$$a_i$$$ indicates the number of candies in bag i$$$i$$$.
output: The output must be a single line. If it is impossible to find an order as requested, print −1$$$-1$$$. Otherwise, print N$$$N$$$ integers separated by spaces, indicating a valid ordering of the ai$$$a_i$$$ values that guarantees that the candies will be divided equally among the siblings.

legend.ai: Karamell、Caramel、Caramello 或 Caramelo。虽然语言不同，但你知道我说的是什么。Alice 和 Bob 是双胞胎，而且他们也喜欢焦糖！因此，作为生日礼物，他们要求为正在组织的聚会上的所有宾客准备焦糖。
聚会当天，Alice 和 Bob 收到了他们的礼物：N$$$N$$$ 袋焦糖。第 i$$$i$$$ 袋中装有 ai$$$a_i$$$ 颗焦糖。
Alice 和 Bob 不想立刻打开袋子，于是决定按如下方式分配焦糖：依次考虑这些袋子，在第 i$$$i$$$ 步，将第 i$$$i$$$ 个袋子中的 ai$$$a_i$$$ 颗焦糖给当时拥有焦糖数量较少的人。如果两人的数量相同，则将焦糖给 Alice(毕竟“女士优先”)。
他们不喜欢的一点是，根据考虑袋子的顺序不同，每个人最终收到的焦糖数量可能不同。例如，如果袋子中的糖果数量按序列 [1,2,2,3]$$$[1, 2, 2, 3]$$$ 排列，Alice 最终会得到 3$$$3$$$ 颗糖，Bob 会得到 5$$$5$$$ 颗糖。另一方面，如果按照 [1,2,3,2]$$$[1, 2, 3, 2]$$$ 的顺序考虑，两人最终都会得到 4$$$4$$$ 颗糖。
你忘记为过生日的孩子买糖果了，不过你决定送给他们一个更加有趣的礼物：编写一个程序，在可能的情况下确定一种排列袋子的方式，使 Alice 和 Bob 获得相同数量的糖果。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$(1≤N≤100)$$$1 \leq N \leq 100)$$$，表示袋子的数量。第二行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个整数 a1,…,aN$$$a_1, \ldots, a_N$$$(1≤ai≤100)$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 100)$$$，其中 ai$$$a_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个袋子中的糖果数量。

output.ai: 输出一行。如果无法找到满足要求的顺序，输出 −1$$$-1$$$。否则，输出 N$$$N$$$ 个用空格分隔的整数，表示一种有效的 ai$$$a_i$$$ 数值排列，保证糖果会在兄弟姐妹之间平均分配。
